package_info.why_malicious: The package is a backdoored application that requests unnecessary permissions, loads native code to inject clicker functionality into ad SDKs, communicates with a C&C server for configuration, and performs automated ad fraud by simulating user clicks. This behavior is not expected in a legitimate compass app and is designed to generate fraudulent ad revenue.

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At device boot, the code loads a native library and starts a background process that initiates the clicker attack chain.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The receiver requests BOOT_COMPLETED permission and loads a native library unrelated to compass functionality.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: A compass app should not need to run code at boot or load native libraries for background operations.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Some legitimate apps (e.g., alarms, device managers) may use BOOT_COMPLETED, but not compass apps.

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: After device boot, the native code registers two background workers: one to fetch configuration from a C&C server, and another to inject code into ad SDKs for click fraud.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Native code is used to evade detection and perform background operations unrelated to app purpose.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Compass apps should not download remote configurations or inject code into other libraries.

execution_context.trigger: ad display (runtime, when ad SDK activity is created)
execution_context.file_location: Injected into AdMob/Facebook SDKs (onCreate method), yzt.sta method

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At ad display time, the injected code uses MotionEvent to simulate user clicks on ads via reflection, resulting in fraudulent ad engagement.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Simulating user clicks on ads is a classic click fraud technique and is not legitimate app behavior.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Apps should not programmatically generate ad clicks; only real user interaction is allowed.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Automated UI testing frameworks may use similar code, but not in production apps.
key_indicators: Reflection to invoke ad SDK methods

execution_context.file_location: Worker thread in JHandler, network communication code

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: Periodically, the code contacts a remote C&C server to download updated configuration for click fraud operations.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Contacting hardcoded C&C servers for configuration is a hallmark of malware.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Legitimate apps should not fetch remote code/configuration for hidden functionality.

attack_chain.action: App is installed and requests unnecessary permissions (e.g., BOOT_COMPLETED).
attack_chain.leads_to: Malicious code is set to run at device boot.

attack_chain.action: At device boot, BaseReceiver loads native library and starts background workers.
attack_chain.leads_to: Background workers are registered for C&C communication and click injection.

attack_chain.action: Worker contacts C&C server to fetch configuration for click fraud.
attack_chain.leads_to: Configuration is applied for clicker operation.

attack_chain.action: Injected code in ad SDKs simulates user clicks on ads using MotionEvent.
attack_chain.leads_to: Fraudulent ad engagement and revenue generation.

behavioral_signatures: App requests BOOT_COMPLETED permission without clear justification
Loading of suspicious native libraries at startup
Background workers communicating with hardcoded C&C servers
Code injection into ad SDKs (AdMob, Facebook) at runtime
Use of MotionEvent or reflection to simulate ad clicks
file_indicators: Presence of native library files (e.g., libkagu-lib.so)
Injected or modified ad SDK classes
network_indicators: Frequent HTTP requests to remote configuration endpoints
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for apps requesting BOOT_COMPLETED or other unnecessary permissions, loading native libraries unrelated to their stated function, and making network connections to known C&C servers. Analyze runtime behavior for code injection into ad SDKs and the use of MotionEvent/reflection to simulate user interaction with ads. Flag apps that download and execute remote configurations or exhibit clicker patterns.
